scoreboard.title: Small-scale CMS replication of Nested Learning trends
scoreboard.current_evidence: P1 (3-level) achieves 0.1318 target token logit probability on MK-NIAH vs B4 (1-level) at 0.0479 (+175.2%) under zero retrieval. However, on QASPER and LongHealth, 1-level B4 outperforms 3-level P1 (QASPER F1: 0.1025 vs 0.0896; LongHealth Acc: 23.33% vs 16.67%). P2 performance (0.1830 F1) is driven by BM25 retrieval.
scoreboard.valid_metric: Target token logit probability on synthetic MK-NIAH needle probe (controlled for retrieval).
scoreboard.limitation: Trend does not hold monotonically on natural reading comprehension tasks. Conflation occurs if P2 is used instead of pure memory P1.
scoreboard.next_experiment: Scale backbone beyond 135M to 1B-3B parameters on external GPU to test whether reading comprehension benefits emerge with greater model capacity.

scoreboard.title: Structure-aligned updating vs fixed-token updating at matched budget
scoreboard.current_evidence: Strictly controlled Phase 4.2 comparison P1 (SA-CMS 3-level, 0.8056) vs B5 (Token-CMS 3-level, 0.8007) on 90 samples yields p=0.4143 (paired t-test), p=0.8589 (Wilcoxon), Cohen's d=0.0865. Difference is statistically non-significant.
scoreboard.valid_metric: Controlled paired difference (mean diff = +0.0049), two-tailed p-values, and effect size under identical 5.3M param budget and update counts.
scoreboard.limitation: Insufficient sample size (N=90) and single seed statistical power. P2 vs B4 comparison in prior report was invalid due to retrieval conflation.
scoreboard.next_experiment: High-powered controlled evaluation: P1 vs B5 on N >= 500 evaluation items across 3 seeds (42, 43, 44) on external GPU.

scoreboard.title: Context eviction retention and hybrid refusal safety
scoreboard.current_evidence: In Phase 4.2 context-evicted evaluation, P2 achieves 76.0% correct refusal accuracy (38/50) and 0% false refusal (0/50) on unanswerable queries. However, pure memory models (P1, B5) score 0% refusal (100% false answering).
scoreboard.valid_metric: Empirical refusal accuracy (76.0%) and faithfulness under verified context eviction (direct document context removed from prompt).
scoreboard.limitation: Parametric memory alone has zero refusal capability; all unanswerable detection and refusal behavior originates from the BM25 retrieval score threshold.
scoreboard.next_experiment: Calibrate adaptive dual-threshold refusal controller combining BM25 uncertainty with memory hidden state perplexity/entropy on external GPU.

scoreboard.title: Catastrophic forgetting during sequential document ingestion
scoreboard.current_evidence: No empirical checkpoints or evaluation logs exist for P2 sequential ingestion across D0, D0+5, D0+10, D0+20. Phase 4 tracking file 04_rq4_status.csv explicitly marks sequential training as NEED_EXTERNAL_GPU.
scoreboard.valid_metric: None verified on actual model checkpoints. Narrative claim of 88% retention is unbacked.
scoreboard.limitation: Complete absence of empirical data. Memory hardware constraints on local 4GB GPU prevented executing multi-document sequential LoRA updates.
scoreboard.next_experiment: Execute full sequential document ingestion protocol (D0 -> D0+5 -> D0+10 -> D0+20) with actual checkpoint saves and backward transfer evaluation on external GPU.

scoreboard.title: Computational and token resource trade-offs
scoreboard.current_evidence: Peak VRAM of 357.28 MB and serialized checkpoint size of 20.28 MB are empirically validated on local hardware. Single-token decode latency is 58.89 ms, but full generation latency is ~4,249 ms.
scoreboard.valid_metric: Peak VRAM (357.28 MB), disk storage (20.28 MB), and TTFT / single-token decode latency (58.89 ms).
scoreboard.limitation: Latency was previously misreported as full answer generation. Token reductions (-56.2%, -81.2%) are prompt template ceilings without verified answer quality retention.
scoreboard.next_experiment: Profile full-sequence generation throughput (tokens/second) and evaluate ROUGE/F1 retention across Concise and Minimal token modes on benchmark test sets.
